name: zcode-websearch
description: Web search for ZCode through the Tavily API: an MCP server exposing a two-step tool pair — web_search discovers source URLs with short snippets, web_fetch reads exactly one URL in full — plus guidance on when to search and how to cite results.

tavily_api_key.description: Tavily API key (starts with tvly-). Required for both tools; get one at https://app.tavily.com. Without it the server starts but every call reports a missing-key error.

base_url.description: Tavily API base URL. Change only for a proxy or self-hosted Tavily-compatible endpoint.

timeout_ms.description: Per-request timeout in milliseconds. Raise it for advanced search on slow networks; the host allows this MCP server up to 60s per call.

search_max_results.description: Sources returned by one web_search call. This is a deployment limit, not a tool argument: the model cannot raise it, which is what keeps one search from flooding the context window.

search_max_queries.description: Queries accepted in one web_search call. Related questions batch into a single call whose sources merge and de-duplicate, so one context entry covers several searches.

search_snippet_chars.description: Characters kept per source snippet in a search result. Snippets are for deciding what to read, not for reading: web_fetch returns the page itself.

search_answer_chars.description: Characters kept of Tavily's synthesized answer to the query.

fetch_max_output_chars.description: Characters kept from a fetched page. Raising it lets one page fill more of the context window; the truncation notice tells the model to fetch a narrower URL instead.

max_output_chars.description: Hard cap on the whole text one call returns, whichever tool ran. Kept well under the host's 50 KB model-side budget so this plugin's truncation notice is the one seen.

search_depth.description: Tavily search depth: 'basic' or 'advanced'. Deployment policy rather than a tool argument, so depth cannot be raised by accident per call; 'advanced' costs more and returns longer snippets.

fetch_depth.description: Tavily extract depth: 'basic' or 'advanced'. 'advanced' retrieves more content per page, including tables and embedded data.
